questions.question: How many API calls does the Free plan include per month?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The Free plan includes 1,000 API calls per month.

questions.question: How much does the Pro plan cost per seat per month?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The Pro plan costs $49 per month per seat.

questions.question: How long is chunk data retained on the Pro plan?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Pro plan data is retained for 90 days.

questions.question: Does the Enterprise plan include an uptime SLA, and what percentage is guaranteed?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Yes, the Enterprise plan includes a 99.9% uptime SLA.

questions.question: What discount applies to annual billing on the Pro and Enterprise plans?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Annual billing gets a 15% discount on the total contract value.

questions.question: What happens if I cancel my subscription in the middle of a billing period?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period, and no partial refunds are issued for the remaining days.

questions.question: What payment methods does Synergy Labs accept?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Visa, Mastercard, and American Express for monthly billing; Enterprise customers can also pay by wire transfer against a quarterly invoice.

questions.question: What are Synergy Labs' standard support hours?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Standard support is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time.

questions.question: Is Synergy Labs SOC 2 compliant, and when was the audit completed?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Yes, Synergy Labs completed its SOC 2 Type II audit in March 2025 and re-certifies annually.

questions.question: What is the default API rate limit per key?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The default rate limit is 60 requests per minute per API key.

questions.question: How can Enterprise customers get a higher API rate limit?
questions.ground_truth_answer: By contacting their account manager; Enterprise customers can request up to 600 requests per minute.

questions.question: How is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3, with encryption keys rotated every 90 days.

questions.question: Can customers export their data, and does it cost extra?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Yes, customers on any plan can export their full dataset as CSV or JSON at any time, with no additional fee.

questions.question: What must I do immediately after creating my Synergy Labs account?
questions.ground_truth_answer: You must verify your email within 24 hours or the signup link expires.

questions.question: How long does the first data sync typically take for datasets under 1 GB?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The first sync typically completes within 10 minutes for datasets under 1 GB.

questions.question: How long do team invitations remain valid before they expire?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Invitations expire after 7 days if not accepted.

questions.question: How often are alert rules evaluated?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Alerts are evaluated every 60 seconds.

questions.question: What must be configured before activating a workspace, and can activation be undone?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The data source, team, and alerts must be configured first; activation cannot be undone without contacting support.
